content: Samar Ghosh contacted insurance agent Sunita Agarwal to inquire about the next steps and deadline for reactivating their policy via a reinstatement quote. Sunita informed Samar that a fee of ₹5,500 must be paid using the provided link within a 15-day deadline. Samar stated they will make the payment by tomorrow and requested confirmation upon receipt.

action_items: Customer to pay the reinstatement fee of ₹5,500 by tomorrow
Agent to confirm payment receipt once processed
